# Auralis - Clean Paper Workflow
Source: Neuform staff featured templates. Author: Samnang Aing (@samnang). Views: 27; favorites: 3; remixes: 0.
Tags: pricing, section, animated, cta, billing.
## Overview
Auralis Clean Pricing Section is designed for comparing plans and supporting conversion decisions. Key features include plan comparison blocks and conversion-oriented actions. It is suitable for subscription pricing pages and plan comparison experiences.

Auralis Platform Solutions Resources Pricing Start free Loved by 500+ creative teams Build seamless systems with intelligent precision Auralis transforms chaotic processes and disconnected toolchains into unified, autom…
## Composition
Use the attached HTML reference as the source of truth. Preserve the visible hierarchy, first-screen composition, section rhythm, density, and interaction tone before adapting copy or content.
Key visible headings include: Build seamless systems with intelligent precision.
## Colors
Anchor the palette in primary #B98A45, secondary #15171C, accent #FFE8B8, background #15171C, surface #322A1F, text-primary #FFFFFF. Keep background, surface, text, and border roles distinct so generated layouts retain the same contrast pattern as the source.
## Typography
Use Archivo for display moments and Instrument Serif for body copy unless the HTML clearly demands a compatible fallback. Labels and technical metadata should use IBM Plex Mono or an equivalent mono face.
## Layout
Keep spacing deliberate and stable. Favor the same grid direction, max-width behavior, card density, and responsive stacking seen in the HTML. Do not replace distinctive source structures with generic SaaS sections.
## Components
Authentication and CTA controls should preserve the source button hierarchy, input density, and focused conversion path.
## Motion
Preserve existing motion cues such as masked reveals, staggered entrance, hover lift, scroll-triggered transitions, and ambient movement. Keep easing smooth and restrained.
## WebGL & Effects

If the source includes canvas, WebGL, Three.js, gradients, particles, or atmospheric effects, rebuild them as supporting layers behind the content. Keep effects performant, responsive, and secondary to the interface.

## Guardrails
- Do not flatten the source into a generic card grid.
- Do not swap the color mode unless the source clearly supports it.
- Preserve the first viewport signal, focal object, and visual density.
- Keep buttons, cards, and badges aligned to the same radius and border language.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Auralis — Graphite Workflow System</title>

  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script src="https://code.iconify.design/iconify-icon/1.0.7/iconify-icon.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/gsap.min.js"></script>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,300..700&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=Geist:wght@300;400;450;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap"
    rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    :root {
      --outside: #d9d2c4;
      --outside-2: #cfc6b6;

      --paper: #fbf8ef;
      --paper-soft: #f2ece0;
      --paper-deep: #e8dfcf;

      --ink: #15171c;
      --ink-soft: #4e535d;
      --ink-muted: #8b877f;

      --graphite: #2d3037;
      --graphite-2: #181b21;
      --graphite-3: #090b0f;

      --brass: #b98a45;
      --brass-2: #d9b36f;
      --brass-3: #f1d79d;

      --sage: #7f8b78;
      --line: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.10);
      --line-strong: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.16);

      --display: "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif;
      --serif: "Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif;
      --body: "Geist", system-ui, sans-serif;
      --mono: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;

      --ease: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      background: var(--outside);
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      font-family: var(--body);
      color: var(--ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 16%, rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.12), transparent 30rem),
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% 78%, rgba(45, 48, 55, 0.12), transparent 34rem),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #e5dccd 0%, #d9d2c4 52%, #c9c0b0 100%);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      selection-color: #fff8ea;
      selection-background: var(--graphite);
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button {
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      font: inherit;
      color: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .page-pad {
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: clamp(12px, 2vw, 24px);
      display: flex;
    }

    .master-shell {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 98rem;
      min-height: calc(100vh - clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px));
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: clamp(28px, 4vw, 54px);
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84), transparent 31rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fffdf7 0%, #fbf8ef 56%, #eee6d8 100%);
      box-shadow:
        0 48px 130px rgba(50, 42, 31, 0.18),
        0 20px 54px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.10),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    #topographic-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0.82;
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
    }

    .noise {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -50%;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0.18;
      mix-blend-mode: soft-light;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 260 260' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.82' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      animation: grain 9s steps(6) infinite;
    }

    .soft-vignette {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 37%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58), transparent 27rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(251, 248, 239, 0.10), rgba(251, 248, 239, 0.92) 95%);
    }

    header {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 20;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 26px clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .brand {
      justify-self: start;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 13px;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .brand-mark {
      position: relative;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 34% 24%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78), transparent 33%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, #f5ead5, #b98a45);
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.14);
      box-shadow:
        0 14px 30px rgba(65, 47, 25, 0.12),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78),
        inset 0 -10px 18px rgba(45, 48, 55, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .brand-mark::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--graphite);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.36);
    }

    .brand-mark::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.22);
      border-left-color: transparent;
      transform: rotate(-24deg);
    }

    .brand-text {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .brand-name {
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 620;
      font-variation-settings: "wdth" 108;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .brand-kicker {
      margin-top: 5px;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      color: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.40);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .nav-shell {
      justify-self: center;
      padding: 1px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.14), rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.04), rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.18));
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 42px rgba(50, 42, 31, 0.08),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.80);
    }

    nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.56);
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.06);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    nav a {
      height: 34px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.50);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
    }

    nav a:hover,
    nav a.active {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.055);
    }

    .header-cta {
      justify-self: end;
      position: relative;
      height: 42px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 0 7px 0 17px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #fff9ed;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 248, 230, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 42%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #090b0f 0%, #2d3037 54%, #5f5544 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 232, 184, 0.24);
      text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52);
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 42px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.18),
        0 8px 18px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.14),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20),
        inset 0 -12px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.25s ease;
    }

    .header-cta::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24), transparent);
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      animation: shimmer 5.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .header-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      filter: saturate(1.04);
      box-shadow:
        0 24px 54px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.24),
        0 10px 22px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.18),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24),
        inset 0 -12px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .header-cta span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: #17191e;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 34% 24%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55), transparent 34%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #f3d99d, #b98a45);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
        0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
    }

    .mobile-menu {
      display: none;
      justify-self: end;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.56);
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.08);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    main {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 62px) clamp(20px, 4vw, 64px) clamp(36px, 5vw, 68px);
    }

    .hero-inner {
      width: min(100%, 1180px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .trust-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 34px;
      padding: 8px 14px 8px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.60);
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.08);
      box-shadow:
        0 12px 30px rgba(50, 42, 31, 0.06),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    }

    .avatars {
      display: flex;
      margin-left: 2px;
    }

    .avatar {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 2px solid var(--paper);
      margin-left: -8px;
      object-fit: cover;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.10);
      filter: saturate(0.88) contrast(1.02);
    }

    .avatar:first-child {
      margin-left: 0;
    }

    .trust-copy {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1px;
      color: var(--brass);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .trust-copy small {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      color: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.46);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .hero-headline {
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 1080px;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: clamp(56px, 7.2vw, 112px);
      line-height: 0.92;
      letter-spacing: -0.052em;
      font-weight: 660;
      font-variation-settings: "wdth" 102;
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .headline-line {
      display: block;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 0.03em 0 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: -0.055em;
    }

    .headline-line > span {
      display: inline-block;
      transform: translateY(105%);
      transform-origin: left bottom;
      opacity: 0;
      filter: blur(10px);
      will-change: transform, opacity, filter;
    }

    .headline-accent {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--serif);
      color: var(--graphite);
      font-style: italic;
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    }

    .headline-accent::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0.02em;
      right: 0.02em;
      bottom: 0.04em;
      height: 0.08em;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.22), rgba(217, 179, 111, 0.38));
      z-index: -1;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left;
    }

    .hero-headline strong {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 660;
      letter-spacing: -0.052em;
    }

    .loaded .headline-line > span {
      animation: headlineReveal 1s var(--ease) forwards;
      animation-delay: var(--delay, 0s);
    }

    .loaded .headline-accent::after {
      animation: accentSweep 1.05s var(--ease) forwards;
      animation-delay: 0.84s;
    }

    .subheadline {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 34px auto 0;
      color: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.56);
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.35vw, 19px);
      line-height: 1.74;
      letter-spacing: -0.018em;
    }

    .cta-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 38px;
    }

    .btn-primary,
    .btn-secondary {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 54px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      border-radius: 17px;
      padding: 0 24px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.012em;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition:
        transform 0.25s var(--ease),
        box-shadow 0.25s ease,
        border-color 0.25s ease,
        color 0.25s ease;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      color: #fff8ea;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 42%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #080a0e 0%, #181b21 36%, #2d3037 72%, #5b5547 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 232, 184, 0.24);
      text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52);
      box-shadow:
        0 24px 60px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.24),
        0 12px 26px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.14),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20),
        inset 0 -14px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .btn-primary::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), transparent);
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      animation: shimmer 4.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow:
        0 32px 76px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.30),
        0 14px 30px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.18),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24),
        inset 0 -14px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
    }

    .btn-primary iconify-icon {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover iconify-icon {
      transform: translateX(3px);
    }

    .btn-primary span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      color: rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.72);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88), rgba(244, 237, 225, 0.76));
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.12);
      box-shadow:
        0 14px 28px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.07),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92),
        inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.05);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      color: var(--ink);
      border-color: rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.38);
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 36px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.10),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96),
        0 0 34px rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .workflow-strip {
      width: min(100%, 880px);
      margin-top: 58px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .workflow-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 130px;
      padding: 18px;
      text-align: left;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74), rgba(247, 241, 231, 0.54)),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40);
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.09);
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 44px rgba(50, 42, 31, 0.08),
        0 6px 16px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.04),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86),
        inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.045);
      overflow: hidden;
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      transition:
        transform 0.28s var(--ease),
        box-shadow 0.28s ease,
        border-color 0.28s ease,
        background 0.28s ease;
    }

    .workflow-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 1px;
      border-radius: 23px;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 14%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62), transparent 28%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.08), transparent 42%);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .workflow-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 18px;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.66), transparent);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
    }

    .workflow-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      border-color: rgba(185, 138, 69, 0.30);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82), rgba(247, 241, 231, 0.62)),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48);
      box-shadow:
        0 26px 58px rgba(50, 42, 31, 0.13),
        0 10px 24px rgba(21, 23, 28, 0.07),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
    }

    .workflow-card:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .workflow-icon {

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById("topographic-canvas");
    const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", {
      alpha: true,
      antialias: false,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    if (gl) {
      const vsSource = `
        attribute vec4 aVertexPosition;

        void main() {
          gl_Position = aVertexPosition;
        }
      `;

      const fsSource = `
        precision highp float;

        uniform vec2 uResolution;
        uniform float uTime;
        uniform vec2 uPointer;

        mat2 rot(float a) {
          float s = sin(a);
          float c = cos(a);
          return mat2(c, -s, s, c);
        }

        float hash(vec2 p) {
          return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453123);
        }

        float noise(vec2 p) {
          vec2 i = floor(p);
          vec2 f = fract(p);

          float a = hash(i);
          float b = hash(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
          float c = hash(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
          float d = hash(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));

          vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);

          return mix(a, b, u.x) +
            (c - a) * u.y * (1.0 - u.x) +
            (d - b) * u.x * u.y;
        }

        float fbm(vec2 p) {
          float value = 0.0;
          float amp = 0.5;

          for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            value += amp * noise(p);
            p = rot(0.52) * p * 2.04 + 10.4;
            amp *= 0.48;
          }

          return value;
        }

        void main() {
          vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / uResolution.xy;
          vec2 p = uv - 0.5;
          p.x *= uResolution.x / uResolution.y;

          vec2 pointer = uPointer * 0.035;

          vec3 paper = vec3(0.984, 0.973, 0.938);
          vec3 paperWarm = vec3(0.929, 0.893, 0.831);
          vec3 graphite = vec3(0.176, 0.188, 0.216);
          vec3 brass = vec3(0.725, 0.541, 0.271);
          vec3 sage = vec3(0.498, 0.545, 0.471);

          vec2 field = (p + pointer) * 1.08;
          field *= rot(-0.08 + sin(uTime * 0.07) * 0.016);

          float n = fbm(field * 2.05 + vec2(uTime * 0.020, -uTime * 0.014));
          float ridges = abs(fract(n * 10.0) - 0.5);
          float topo = smoothstep(0.036, 0.0, ridges);

          float fine = abs(fract(n * 25.0) - 0.5);
          float micro = smoothstep(0.018, 0.0, fine);

          float center = smoothstep(0.60, 0.16, length(p - vec2(0.0, 0.02)));
          float edge = smoothstep(0.94, 0.18, length(p));

          vec3 col = mix(paper, paperWarm, n * 0.22);
          col = mix(col, brass, topo * 0.085 * (1.0 - center * 0.72));
          col = mix(col, graphite, micro * 0.026 * (1.0 - center * 0.72));
          col = mix(col, sage, topo * 0.030 * (1.0 - center * 0.84));

          float grain = hash(gl_FragCoord.xy + uTime * 18.0) * 0.020;
          col -= grain;

          col = mix(col * 0.94, col, edge);
          col = mix(col, paper, center * 0.26);

          gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
        }
      `;

      function createShader(gl, type, source) {
        const shader = gl.createShader(type);
        gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
        gl.compileShader(shader);

        if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
          console.error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
          gl.deleteShader(shader);
          return null;
        }

        return shader;
      }

      const vertexShader = createShader(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vsSource);
      const fragmentShader = createShader(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fsSource);

      const program = gl.createProgram();
      gl.attachShader(program, vertexShader);
      gl.attachShader(program, fragmentShader);
      gl.linkProgram(program);

      if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
        console.error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));
      }

      const positionAttributeLocation = gl.getAttribLocation(program, "aVertexPosition");
      const positionBuffer = gl.createBuffer();

      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positionBuffer);

      const positions = new Float32Array([
        -1, -1,
        1, -1,
        -1, 1,
        1, 1
      ]);

      gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positions, gl.STATIC_DRAW);

      const resolutionUniformLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uResolution");
      const timeUniformLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uTime");
      const pointerUniformLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uPointer");

      let startTime = performance.now();

      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        ex: 0,
        ey: 0
      };

      window.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

        pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5) * 2;
        pointer.y = ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5) * -2;
      }, { passive: true });

      function resize() {
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.7);
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

        canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
        canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;

        gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      }

      window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
      resize();

      function render(time) {
        pointer.ex += (pointer.x - pointer.ex) * 0.035;
        pointer.ey += (pointer.y - pointer.ey) * 0.035;

        gl.useProgram(program);
        gl.enableVertexAttribArray(positionAttributeLocation);
        gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positionBuffer);
        gl.vertexAttribPointer(positionAttributeLocation, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

        gl.uniform2f(resolutionUniformLocation, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        gl.uniform1f(timeUniformLocation, (time - startTime) * 0.001);
        gl.uniform2f(pointerUniformLocation, pointer.ex, pointer.ey);

        gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);

        requestAnimationFrame(render);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(render);
    }
  </script>
